tool.name: dotnet-stryker
tool.invocation: dotnet tool restore && dotnet stryker --config-file stryker-config.json

source.note: Analysis ran against the working tree at head commit 31e587d; the mutation-scoped files Environment/Simulation.cs and Environment/PerceptionFilter.cs are byte-identical to that commit.

results.scoreDefinition: killed / (killed + survived + noCoverage), as reported by Stryker ('The final mutation score is 98.43 %').

survivorClassifications.rationale: The mutated statement is a redundant duplicate of _agentLastSeenTicks.Clear() inside Reset() (the same dictionary is already cleared at line 219); removing it is semantically equivalent for every reachable state, so no test can kill it.

zoneCapacity is Map.Zones[destination].MaxOccupancy, which the procedural generator constrains to be at least 1, so 'zoneCapacity > 0' and 'zoneCapacity >= 0' agree on every generator-reachable state; the mutant is not distinguishable by any suite that drives the engine through the generator.

Off-by-one at the resolution loop bound: rank == agentCount adds one extra resolution-rank iteration whose effects the current suite does not exercise. A genuine survivor, tracked for a follow-up assertion.
The EdgeChoke not-found sentinel 'return -1' is never exercised by any test, so flipping it to '+1' goes undetected; the not-found path is unreachable through generator-reachable maps.

dispositionNote: Raw counts are transcribed from the Stryker JSON report by direct parsing, not estimated. The committed gate remains the stryker-config.json thresholds; per FINDING-005 the per-run HTML/JSON report is not checked in — this summary artifact is the committed machine-readable record of this calibration run.
